In this paper, we use wavelet functions as both basis functions and weight functions. it is a reasonable trade-off between the entire domain and subsection basis functions. The whole domain may be divided into several subsections, while in each subsection the higher resolution basis is incorporated, which preserve the merits of entire domain basis functions.
